name: BJCORP
recent: Berjaya Corporation 近期获得一项价值 RM675 million 的 Sanglang Port 开发工程合约，由旗下 Berjaya Construction 承接。公司同时发布 2026 财政年年度报告，并将在 12 月 11 日召开第 25 届常年股东大会。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收环比增长 4.2%，但同比减少 3.6%，净亏损为 RM109.0 million。
notable: Berjaya Construction 获得价值 RM675 million 的 Sanglang Port 开发工程合约。
公司发布 2026 财政年年度报告及企业治理报告。
董事局将于 2026 年 12 月 11 日召开第 25 届常年股东大会。
risks: 彭亨州当局对该公司采取执法行动。
公司有一项涉及清盘 / 接管人 / 限制令 / 特别管理人的公告。
董事 Tan Sri Dato' Seri Vincent Tan Chee Yioun 在闭市期表示有意进行证券交易。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM2,282.4 million，环比增长 4.2%，同比减少 3.6%；净亏损为 RM109.0 million，净亏损率为 4.8%，较上一季度的 8.0% 净亏损率有所收窄。

recent_en: Berjaya Corporation recently secured a RM675 million development works contract for Sanglang Port, undertaken by its subsidiary Berjaya Construction. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 4.2% QoQ but fell 3.6% YoY, with a net loss of RM109.0 million.
notable_en: Berjaya Construction secured a RM675 million development works contract for Sanglang Port.
The company released its FY2026 Annual Report and Corporate Governance Report.
risks_en: Enforcement action by Pahang state authorities against the company.
The company has an announcement related to winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
Director Tan Sri Dato' Seri Vincent Tan Chee Yioun indicated intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM2,282.4 million, up 4.2% QoQ but down 3.6% YoY; net loss was RM109.0 million, with a net loss margin of 4.8%, narrower than the previous quarter's 8.0% net loss margin.
